# Documentation Graph Index

[English](graph-atlas.md) | 中文

These diagrams show relationships that the generated catalogs do not. Use them to find package relationships, capability seams, event flow, model-facing tools, app composition, and runtime lifecycle paths. Exact signatures and type definitions still live in the [subsystem pages](subsystems/core.zh.md) (types and the generated `cordis-surface` regions) and [tool-catalog.md](tool-catalog.zh.md).

The process decision behind this index is recorded in [the documentation graph Agent Note](../.agents/notes/archived/process/2026-07-03-documentation-graph-atlas.md).
